localPrices.intro: Explore local market observations by market, supplier and price category, with the cost basis behind each price.

localPrices.emptyBody: Try another code or broaden the market, supplier, category or date filters.
localPrices.basisNote: Local market evidence is kept separate from international prices. Categories, units and included costs may differ; these demo prices are not customs valuations.

localPrices.coffeeSpec: Demo unroasted coffee · sample grade A
localPrices.converterSpec: Demo static converter · sample model SC-01
localPrices.inclusionNote: Unknown means the record does not specify whether the cost is included. No tax rate is assumed and no costs are added to or removed from the quoted price.
localPrices.provenanceNote: This record, supplier and market are frontend fixtures, not a real market survey or supplier quotation. Verification dates and statuses are illustrative. The original total equals unit price multiplied by quantity.

prices.intro: Explore international trade observations and inspect the source behind each price.
prices.demoNotice: Synthetic records for exploring this workspace. Prices, sources and review statuses are illustrative; no live data is connected.
prices.dateError: The end date must be on or after the start date.
prices.tableCaption: Synthetic international observations in their original currency and unit.
prices.emptyBody: Try another code or broaden the country, source or date filters.
prices.basisNote: Each observation retains its own currency, unit and trade basis. These demo prices are not customs valuations or directly comparable across products.
prices.originalCurrency: Original currency · no exchange-rate conversion applied
prices.provenanceNote: This record was created as a frontend fixture, not retrieved from a trade provider. Its source reference and review status are examples only. The original total equals unit price multiplied by quantity.
